### Skin in the game, head in the sand

[Sponsor commitment and SPAC outcomes]{.paper-sub}

::: {.paper-links}
[Abstract](#){data-bs-toggle="collapse"} [PDF](papers/paper1.pdf) [SSRN](#)

::: {.abstract}
Using manual extraction of lock-up agreements and sponsor capital commitments
from 1,525 SPAC prospectuses filed between 2006 and 2024, we test whether
financial commitment mechanisms discipline sponsor behaviour.
